results.title: Until God Remembers Us
results.original_title: Hasta que Dios se acuerde de nosotros

results.title: 100 Liters of Gold
results.overview: Middle-aged sisters Taina and Pirkko are famous for their Finnish farmhouse ale called “sahti”.  The third sister, Päivi, is getting married, and she asks her sisters if they can make 100 liters of sahti for the wedding. Unfortunately, it’s too good not to drink it. The sisters wake up in a horrible hangover and realize they have drunk it all. They have 24 hours to find 100 liters of good sahti, or they will lose all the respect.

results.title: The Next 24 Hours
results.overview: After a sexual assault, a young woman navigates a cold and bureaucratic system over the course of 24 hours, fighting to reclaim her safety and sanity while battling the manipulations of her assailant.

results.title: Dutch National Opera: The Maid of Orleans
results.original_title: Opéra national des Pays-Bas : La Pucelle d'Orléans
results.overview: In a court trial, Joan of Arc is charged with high treason ...  Dmitri Cherniakov presents a modern reinterpretation of Tchaikovsky’s least frequently performed opera, set entirely in a courtroom, with soprano Elena Stikhina in the title role.

results.title: Blood Red
results.overview: Alix, 24, cannot have biological children. When her roommate and friend Suzie becomes pregnant, Alix begins experiencing hallucinations related to the world of pregnancy.

results.title: Birds Two by Two
results.overview: An old hermit, living with his ducks in the woods, is kidnapped for not conforming by the state's children's army. In prison the old man undergoes a torturous re-education by fierce classical musicians. A courageous fellow prisoner heals him with love and they attempt an escape.

results.title: Memory For Burial
results.overview: Surviving against all odds. In 1940, Benjamin Orenstein, just a teenager, was sent to his first concentration camp in Poland. It was the beginning of a journey that would mark him for life. After years of silence, he now bears witness to one of the darkest chapters in history.

results.title: Passing
results.overview: PASSING follows a young woman who finally gathers the courage to say hello to a stranger on a New York street, capturing the quiet tension of a moment where everything could change. What begins as a simple interaction becomes a window into all the ways we hesitate, imagine, and project possibilities onto the people we cross paths with. The film lingers on that brief space between fear and action, where connection feels both within reach and impossibly fragile.

results.title: Attock
results.overview: In Attock, after losing his pet pigeon, a young boy finds an unexpected moment of peace beneath the open sky.

results.title: Bang Bang
results.overview: Retired pugilist Bernard “Bang Bang” Rozyski is inspired to try his hand at training once he reconnects with his estranged grandson. While their training brings Bang Bang out of the hole he’s been living in, everyone questions his motivations, including an ex-girlfriend from decades ago, who was privy to Bang Bang’s meteoric rise in the sport in the 80s as well as the rivalry with his former opponent, her cousin and Detroit's Mayoral candidate Darnell Washington. Is Bang Bang merely passing down inherited rage, or is there true altruism behind his tutelage?

results.title: Prospect
results.overview: Having recently moved to Montreal, Artiste, a 17-year-old African boy, infiltrates a street basketball competition for the chance to win a dream pair of shoes.  As the competition gets fierce with Jamal, one of the city's top players, we discover that his intentions weren't just to win a simple prize, but to use the only asset at his disposal to prove his worth in a community that sees him as an outsider: his talent for Basketball.

results.title: The World Is Not Enough
results.overview: The short film captures the memory of an apartment and its surroundings: a young adult man lives his daily life, a journalist interviews a retired novelist who grapples with the idea of the end of the world, and two young boys searching for portals. Three storylines intertwine as the film progresses.

results.title: Legend Of The Golden Buffalo
results.original_title: Trạng Quỳnh Nhí: Truyền Thuyết Kim Ngưu
results.overview: Adventures of Quynh and his group of friends, along with a mysterious water buffalo.

results.title: Greed
results.overview: An everyday average-joe named Steven gets an ominous wishing stone while gambling with a group of friends. The stone grants any wish, creating a slippery slope for its user.

results.title: Tomar Jonno Mon
results.overview: During a trip to Cox’s Bazar, Piu meets Raownak, a boy from her own town. Amid the waves and sunsets, a tender romance blooms. But after returning home, Piu discovers Raownak’s hidden truth—he belongs to a powerful, controversial family. Torn between love and reality, she must decide whether to trust her heart or let their story fade away like the sea’s distant waves.

results.title: Adorable Humans
results.overview: As supernatural forces slip through the cracks, four destinies are intertwined, and four souls are forced to confront their demons. A young woman’s hope for a fresh start is derailed by a mysterious enchanted mirror, while her psychiatrist is struck by visions of a terrifying accident. In the nearby city, a care worker uncovers dark and perverted secrets as he tends to a dying man, and writer’s block turns demonic for an ambitious musician.

results.title: Are You Fucking Kidding Me?!
results.overview: Party clown Bobo endures the birthday gig from hell, involving a snarky coworker and nightmare clients.

results.title: The Furies
results.overview: Waterloo will now have its own semi-pro men's hockey team, thus expelling the amateur women's leagues from the arena. To avenge their lost ice time, an impulsive hockey player and a ruthless octogenarian—a former derby champion—have a plan: recruit the city's disenfranchised and form an underground roller derby team. With the help of the Women's Club, they will prove that women's sports can also inspire crowds and that sisterhood is the ultimate act of resistance.
